title: Evaluation of Fairness Trade-offs in Predicting Student Success
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its analysis is focused on fairness concerning racial-ethnic and gender groups.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. The benchmark measures fairness (demographic parity, equality of opportunity, positive predictive parity) in a student success prediction model with respect to race/ethnicity and gender.
